industry.why: Overweight, carried unchanged and better supported. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): two houses now name staples as the place to be, Jefferies' desk (17 Oct) favouring 'pricing-power defensives such as staples and utilities' as energy inflation seeps into core goods and Danske (18 Oct) calling them 'not a bad place to hide'; energy, utilities and staples led the week and European defensives beat cyclicals by 4.7 points over four weeks (37-breadth-and-defensives.md). Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: C now, D prior, so the market has started to pay. Not Double Overweight: the multiples that make staples defensive derate with a 5.10% ten-year, and a defensive destination four weeks into a rotation is a crowded one. The sector rows carry B on Beverages, Tobacco, Household products, Food retail and Food production. Moves to A if defensives lead for a second month with the industry's relative strength at B or better.

sector.why: Overweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): defensive volumes and cash yield, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows; no source spoke to beverages this week. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: B now, D prior, agrees. Carlsberg, a live holding (3.98%), improved to D from F on Sell-side Momentum this week and stays in amendment 9's review only as a watch. Counter-case: destocking is in the numbers before the defensiveness is, and multiples derate with yields.

geography.why: Underweight, carried unchanged with the reason strengthened. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): the spillover from France to Italy is the new fact this week (Goldman, 16 Oct, 'tentative spillover to Italy'), and the Italian listings in the Pool are bank-heavy (Monte dei Paschi, Credito Emiliano, Mediobanca) beside global businesses (Eni, Saipem, Tenaris, STMicroelectronics, Technoprobe, Reply). Not Double Underweight because Goldman also says contagion risk is lower than in 2011-15, its fragmentation index shows risk 'remains limited', and Southern European banks are healthier; relative strength is not graded by country. Moves to F if the fragmentation index rises or the Italian premium is read above 150 basis points; back to C under 100.
